title: Grateful Dead Live at International Speedway on 1969-12-28

ai_review.summary: Solid 1969 performance with a fun Mason's Children jam, captured on a rough but listenable soundboard despite some distortion.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its high energy and especially the Mason's Children jam, which reviewers rate highly. The recording is a sound‑board capture that suffers from occasional peaking and tape‑age artifacts, yet remains enjoyable enough to be considered one of the better available tapes from this era.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers gave 4‑star ratings and highlighted a good performance, while noting consistent but not fatal recording issues (distortion, tape wear). The weighted blend of strong show quality and moderate recording quality yields an overall 4‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Levels were set too high causing noticeable distortion; tape is described as sketchy/beat‑up with some hiss, but overall still listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers simply note the show is good and fun.
